proposition.claim:
Recorded check: the inward-normal graph formula has the opposite sign

M=R² allowed by the auxiliary Section4.2 assumptions; E=B1(0), E'=B1(d e1),0<d<1. Distinct smooth equal-area pi isoperimetric sets, positive H=1, inward tube F(z,theta)=(1-z)e_theta for -1<z<1, a=1, K=2. The exact graph w=1-d cos(theta)-sqrt(1-d²sin²theta) tends to0 in C-infinity as d->0, so all fixed smallness bounds can also hold.

Recorded check: the metric estimate needs a smaller tube

Same translated unit disks with fixed a=1,K=2,V=pi. For every0<d<1, graph height norm=d<a and whole boundary lies in punctured B2. Item5 is not an assumption of Lemma4.6.

Recorded check: an unnecessary assertion of unrestricted \(L^p\) compactness

Compact smooth hypersurface dimension m=n-1>=3; a localized smooth bump. Normalization can preserve mean0 and L2norm1 while retaining bounded H1 norm. This example addresses the Sobolev/compactness inference, not the impossible full contradictory Rayleigh sequence.
